eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 单二进制

headline.zh:
Agent 被劫持时
别杀掉整个运行
headline.en:
When an agent is hijacked,
don't kill the whole run

sub.zh: 在入侵那一刻冻结状态，保住能解释"怎么被攻破"的因果链——一条命令看清 agent 已经碰到什么、还能碰到什么。
sub.en: Freeze the state at the moment of compromise and keep the causal chain that explains how the break-in triggered — one command shows what the agent already touched and what it could still reach.

title.zh: 在入侵那一刻冻结状态
title.en: Freeze the state at the moment of compromise

body.zh: 标记被攻破的那一步，导出这一刻的快照：agent 已经走到哪、哪些工具调用还够得着、以及不透明的内部状态点。因果链不断，事后能做受控实验，而不是只剩推断。
body.en: Mark the compromised step and dump the snapshot at that instant: which steps the agent had reached, which tool calls were still reachable, and the opaque internal state checkpoint. The causal chain stays intact — a controlled experiment later, not just an inference.

title.zh: 读你 agent 已经在产的标准格式
title.en: Reads the standard format your agents already emit

body.zh: 直接吃一份标准导出文件，还原成步骤树与工具调用子图。不用改 agent、不用装 collector、不用额外埋点——你已经有的数据就够。
body.en: Ingests a standard export file straight into a step tree and tool-call subgraph. No agent changes, no collector to install, no extra instrumentation — the data you already have is enough.

title.zh: 终端里走查整条因果链
title.en: Walk the whole causal chain in your terminal

body.zh: 一条命令打开导航器，在步骤树里定位入侵点、翻看前后文。单二进制、零配置、离线可用——取证就该这么直接。
body.en: One command opens a navigator to roam the step tree and pin the intrusion in context. Single binary, zero config, fully offline — forensics should be this direct.

headline.zh: 下一次 agent 失控时，先别 kill
headline.en: Next time an agent goes rogue, don't kill it first

sub.zh: 装上 ForkSpan，在被攻破的那一刻把状态冻下来。
sub.en: Install ForkSpan and freeze the state the moment compromise is detected.
